prompt: A square poster with side $x$ has a square photo of side $4$ cut out of it. The leftover area is $x^2 - 16$, which factors as $(x + a)(x - a)$. What is $a$?
hint: This is a difference of squares: $x^2 - 16 = x^2 - (\;?\;)^2$.

hints.text: This is a difference of squares: $x^2 - 16 = x^2 - (\;?\;)^2$.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try numbers: $x = 10$ gives $100 - 16 = 84$, and $(10 + 4)(10 - 4) = 14 \times 6 = 84$. Difference of squares always splits like this.

alternativeExplanations.title: Scissors-and-tape picture
steps: Cut the 4-by-4 photo hole out of the x-by-x poster and snip the leftover L-shape into two pieces.
Slide the pieces into one rectangle: it measures (x + 4) by (x − 4).

alternativeExplanations.title: Check by expanding
steps: The middle terms cancel, and the match confirms a = 4.
